required.quote: Each applicant who desires to practice podiatry shall meet the qualifications prescribed in AS 08.64.200(a)(3) - (5) and shall (1) submit a certificate of graduation from a legally chartered school of podiatry approved by the board; (2) take the examination required by AS 08.64.210

exams.name: Board examination (podiatry)
exams.notes: The board calls to its aid a podiatrist of known ability to assist in the examination. Applicants may be waived under AS 08.64.250 (license by credentials).
exams.quote: take the examination required by AS 08.64.210; the board shall call to its aid a podiatrist of known ability who is licensed to practice podiatry to assist in the examination and licensure of applicants for a license to practice podiatry

interval_years.quote: Licenses shall be renewed biennially on the dates set by the department with the approval of the respective board.

required.quote: the board shall promote a high degree of competence in the practice of medicine, osteopathy, and podiatry by requiring every licensee of medicine, osteopathy, and podiatry in the state to fulfill continuing education requirements

period_years.quote: Before a license may be renewed, the licensee shall submit evidence to the board or its designee that continuing education requirements prescribed by regulations adopted by the board have been met.

value: pain management and opioid use and addiction (minimum 2 hours per 2-year renewal period)
topical_requirements.quote: Continuing education requirements must include not less than two hours of education in pain management and opioid use and addiction in the two years preceding an application for renewal of a license

available.quote: The board may waive the examination requirement and license by credentials if the physician, osteopath, or podiatry applicant meets the requirements of AS 08.64.200, 08.64.205, or 08.64.209, submits proof of continued competence as required by regulation, pays the required fee, and has (1) an active license from a board of medical examiners established under the laws of a state or territory of the United States or a province or territory of Canada issued after thorough examination

requirements.value: Active license from a board of medical examiners in another US state, territory, or Canadian province/territory issued after thorough examination; must meet podiatry qualifications under AS 08.64.209; submit proof of continued competence; pay required fee; demonstrate professional competence in pain management and addiction disorders.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: intentionally or negligently permitted the performance of patient care by persons under the licensee's supervision that does not conform to minimum professional standards even if the patient was not injured

definition_quote.value: the medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the foot, the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot, and superficial lesions of the hand other than those associated with trauma; the use of preparations, medicines, and drugs as are necessary for the treatment of these ailments; the treatment of the local manifestations of systemic diseases as they appear in the hand and foot
definition_quote.quote: "practice of podiatry" means the medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the foot, the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot, and superficial lesions of the hand other than those associated with trauma; the use of preparations, medicines, and drugs as are necessary for the treatment of these ailments; the treatment of the local manifestations of systemic diseases as they appear in the hand and foot

methods_authorized.quote: the medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the foot, the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot

drug_authority.value: May use preparations, medicines, and drugs as necessary for treatment of podiatric ailments
drug_authority.quote: the use of preparations, medicines, and drugs as are necessary for the treatment of these ailments

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the foot, the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot, and superficial lesions of the hand other than those associated with trauma

anesthesia_authority.quote: general anaesthetics may be used only in colleges of podiatry approved by the board and in hospitals approved by the joint commission on the accreditation of hospitals, or the American Osteopathic Association

systemic_disease_treatment_excluded.quote: a patient shall be concurrently referred to a physician or osteopath for the treatment of the systemic disease itself

systemic_disease_local_manifestations_in.quote: the treatment of the local manifestations of systemic diseases as they appear in the hand and foot

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: The board shall adopt regulations authorizing a physician, podiatrist, osteopath, or physician assistant licensed under this chapter to delegate routine medical duties to an agent of the physician, podiatrist, osteopath, or physician assistant.

opioid_prescribing_rules_required.quote: A licensee may not issue (1) an initial prescription for an opioid that exceeds a seven-day supply to an adult patient for outpatient use; (2) a prescription for an opioid that exceeds a seven-day supply to a minor

controlled_substances_prescribing_ce_req.quote: Continuing education requirements must include not less than two hours of education in pain management and opioid use and addiction in the two years preceding an application for renewal of a license

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: under regulations adopted by the board, contract with private professional organizations to establish an impaired medical professionals program to identify, confront, evaluate, and treat persons licensed under this chapter who abuse alcohol, other drugs, or other substances or are mentally ill or cognitively impaired
